stability.rule: buffer = half the median |open->close edge change| in the edge region, rounded to 0.0005, capped at 0.005

wait_rule.rule: WAIT only if n >= 100 edge-region rows with expected CLV < 0 and realized CLV 95% UB < -0.25

same_game.lines: consensus close (spread and total); team-total lines are SYNTHETIC: the archive has none
not_estimable: team-total lines and prices (none in the archive; the synthetic split of the game total is shown)
alternate-line and same-game-parlay PRICES (outcome correlation only; books price SGPs with their own correlation)
moneyline PRICES at decision time (the archive has closing moneylines only; the outcome correlation needs none)
correlation of CLV across books (one opener per game in most DEV seasons)

favorite_spread__game_over.note: the favourite covers and the game goes over

home_spread__game_over.note: home covers and the game goes over

spread__alternate_spread_3pts_better.note: a team covers the line and covers 3 points better

spread__alternate_spread_3pts_worse.note: a team covers the line and covers 3 points worse (same team)

spread__alternate_spread_7pts_worse.note: a team covers the line and covers 7 points worse

spread__moneyline_same_team.note: a team covers and wins outright (same team)

underdog_spread__game_under.note: the underdog covers and the game goes under

decision_model_challenger.rule: adopt only if the AUC gain 95% CI > 0 and the log loss is not worse (POLICY_PREREG §3)

gap_rule.rule: smallest g in {0.5, 1, 1.5, 2} whose rows with |gap| in [g, g+1) have mean CLV 95% LB > 0

rankings.rule: display rankings only if the key decision.js ranks by (the calibrated EV under the frozen artifact) orders realized CLV within weeks (mean Kendall tau 95% CI > 0); a constant key cannot
